items.text: Saquon Barkley ACTIVE for MNF vs Cowboys; postgame said hamstring came out great and back issue won't keep him out.
items.why: ETR expected; Schefter/Rapoport confirmed active and positive postgame comments
items.implication: Gutsy efficient night; clear for ROS if no setback
items.opportunity: Workhorse role restored after multi-week absence

items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/optimism in weekend summary then confirmed ACTIVE for Week 7 vs Raiders despite calf injury.
items.why: ETR weekend report GTD optimism; Schefter/Rapoport confirmed active
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected if no setback; start confidently
items.opportunity: High route/target share with Adams out long-term

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/pessimism in ETR summary; ruled INACTIVE for Week 7 vs Dolphins (quad).
items.why: Pessimistic GTD path confirmed inactive; limited practice prior
items.implication: Missed another week; monitor Week 8 ramp
items.opportunity: Backup RB full workload vs weak Miami run D

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but uncertain severity; later reports expect OK with bye.
items.why: Levitan tape/feel; Garafolo all indications OK with bye
items.implication: Bye helps; monitor Week 9; big game prior (124 yds)
items.opportunity: Lead role regained post-benching; handcuff if available

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turn on purposeful slide; would have been tilting if truly injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Levitan assessment post-ETR watch list; Campbell positive
items.implication: No missed time expected; remains RB1
items.opportunity: Elite usage continues; Lions offense humming

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT for Week 7; close to playing but held, expected next week vs Bills.
items.why: ETR OUT list; Rapoport noted close but out, likely Week 8
items.implication: Huntley continues; Flowers still elite YPRR
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers remains high-upside with or without Lamar

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT for Eagles MNF; creates extra targets in depleted WR room.
items.implication: Elevated roles for remaining PHI pass-catchers; Goedert safer

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/activated for Week 7 return.
items.why: ETR IN list; activated off exempt
items.implication: Immediate RB1/2 workload in GB backfield
items.opportunity: Lead back role restored; ROS value discussion

items.text: Bucky Irving not talked about enough as true workhorse RB.
items.why: Berry Pregame emphasis on workhorse status
items.implication: Start/sit and ROS as RB1/2 lock

items.text: Put some respect on Tee Higgins' name.
items.implication: WR2/3 with upside; not just Chase sidekick

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: worst runner stats but RB13 PPR via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Dead last YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE yet fantasy relevant on goal-line + targets
items.implication: Volume sustains mid-RB1/2 floor despite inefficiency
items.opportunity: Inside-5 and receiving work locked; scheme independent value

items.text: Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; sell-high opportunity if possible.
items.why: Big game but sell into hype
items.implication: Trade value peak; underlying role may not sustain

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 lead, Tank Dell only 6 in return, Noel 15 (turf toe exit).
items.why: Clear alpha route share post-Dell limited return
items.implication: Nico locked WR1 usage; Dell ramp slow

items.text: Xavier Worthy 33 routes (of 36) without Rice; never topped 83 rec yds in 37 career games despite volume.
items.why: Massive route share but historical ceiling cap
items.implication: Volume play but limited upside; fade pure ceiling spots
items.conflict: Routes high vs career yard ceiling low
